name: EventHallusion
description: EventHallusion is a benchmark for diagnosing event hallucinations in video multimodal large language models (VideoLLMs). It assesses susceptibility to language priors and vision-language biases in video understanding and hallucination.
reputation: A recent diagnostic benchmark that has attracted interest in the video-LLM community for probing hallucination and bias, but it is not yet a widely standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on event hallucination in video LLMs; includes a method (Temporal Contrastive Decoding) to mitigate hallucination.
